attchmntText: VISA Chrome Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Visa Chrome Limited published its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in the Business Standard and Sambad newspapers on November 13, 2026. IGL Spirits Limited reported total income from operations of 209.542 crore and a net profit of 8.280 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. RR MetalMakers India Limited announced an open offer for the acquisition of up to 23,42,265 equity shares, representing 26.00 percent of its equity share capital, by RB International Holdings Limited, Suyog Yogesh Desai, and Nikita Suyog Desai. State Bank of India announced the public auction of gold ornaments pledged by Anjan Kumar Saha on November 30, 2026, due to default on a gold loan. Axis Bank Limited issued possession notices for immovable properties in Kolkata and North 24 Parganas, West Bengal, against borrowers Mrs. Soma Chanda Mondal, Mr. Md Robiul Haque, Mr. Nazrul Haque, Mr. Reaul Molya, and Mrs. Rahimabi En.

attchmntText: MA Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: CARE Ratings Limited submitted its Monitoring Agency Report for VISA Chrome Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report concerns the Preferential Issue aggregating Rs. 200 crore. The company raised Rs. 140 crore till date. There was no utilization of funds during the quarter. The entire unutilized amount of Rs. 140 crore remains idle. The monitoring agency confirmed no deviation from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. The means of finance for the disclosed objects have not changed. No major deviation was observed compared to earlier reports. The company continues to incur cash losses as per financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. No government or statutory approvals were required for the issue objects. The report was signed by Richa Bagaria, Associate Director.

attchmntText: VISA Chrome Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement
voiceSummary: VISA Chrome Limited board meeting held on November 12, 2026 approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 21.94 crore for the quarter and 31.50 crore for the half year. Revenue from operations was 135.39 crore for the quarter. The auditor issued a review report highlighting material uncertainty regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern due to accumulated losses, eroded net worth, and current liabilities exceeding current assets. The board granted in-principle approval for a scheme of arrangement to transfer the Raigarh Project undertaking to wholly-owned subsidiary Kalinganagar Chrome Private Limited. This scheme is subject to shareholder and creditor approval, regulatory observations, and National Company Law Tribunal sanction. The subsidiary is applying to change its name to VISA Steel Raigarh Private Limited.
